q1_issues.issue: (PartOf ken_goldstein conference_board) uses PartOf for an employment/affiliation link, but PartOf is licensed only for a component of an object and a member of a group — and conference_board is never typed as a group or anything else.
The proper noun "Conference Board" gets its Name atom but no ordinary kind type atom, which the naming rule requires when the kind word sits inside or beside the name.
(Manner sk_point_1 finally) slots a temporal/discourse adverb into Manner; "finally" answers neither "how" nor any other oblique question.

(ParticleFromNormal 1.5 0.15) renders "almost a year and a half" as a symmetric tight approximation, but "almost" is a directional hedge (strictly under 1.5) and is not one of the listed about/around/approximately or roughly hedges.

q2_gaps: direct quotation as the complement of a speech verb — only finite "that"-clauses are covered
affiliation carried by a proper-noun modifier on a role noun ("Conference Board economist") — the compound rules exclude proper nouns and the naming rule only handles a name that IS the referent
directional approximators ("almost", "nearly", "just over") on a measured quantity — only symmetric hedges have a licensed distribution
discourse/temporal adverbs such as "finally" — no licensed slot
notes: The BeforeBy argument order (end of recession earlier, pointing later) and the prepositional-verb oblique (To sk_point_1 sk_recovery_1) are both correct, as is projecting the definite "end"/"recession" typing out of the seal while keeping the indefinite "a recovery" inside.
